headline: Asian Paints, Kansai Nerolac, and Berger Paints slump up to 27% YTD amid subdued demand
hook: Paint giants slide up to 27% YTD
summary: Asian Paints, Kansai Nerolac, and Berger Paints have seen year-to-date stock declines of up to 27 percent due to subdued demand and competitive pressures. Elara Securities expects a recovery with 12-13 percent revenue growth ahead, though Q2 FY27 demand remains weak. Indian retail investors tracking consumer discretionary stocks should note the pressure on margins and valuations in the sector.
whats_next: Q2 FY27 earnings announcements for paint companies
why_it_matters: Paint stock valuations face pressure ahead of festive demand.
